name: spreadsheetSetRowHidden
description: Shows or hides a row of the active sheet in a spreadsheet workbook. Rows are 1-based. The fluent member form is setRowHidden(row, hidden), with the shorthand members hideRow(row) and showRow(row) and the predicate isRowHidden(row).

params.name: hidden
params.description: True to hide the row, false to show it (default true).

examples.title: Hide a row
examples.description: Hide row 3 and check its hidden state.
